terms.gloss: a place for keeping holy things; a shrine, chapel
evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.4.4: sacrārium magnā cum dignitāte in aedibus, ā majōribus trāditum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A room or place where holy things are kept, also in a private house (Lewis & Short, from the Digest).

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
